why: A recording is usable only if the file we hold can be traced to a source page that names the recordist and the licence. The masters live outside git (~/projects/birdie-curation, ~75 MB); this ledger is the versioned part, so the provenance cannot be lost with the disk. It is not a licence grant: the grant is the deed at the source page, and `verification.needs` lists what has not been checked. A file with a permitted licence but an unverified field is `blocked`, not usable.

states.ready: permitted licence, and recordist, source page, licence version (or PD basis) and digest are recorded
states.blocked: permitted licence family, but a named field is missing; the file cannot be used until it is supplied
states.refused: not permitted, unrecognised, or published without a mapping; unusable short of written permission
